newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Excel Machine offers 43.75 mln shares in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Excel Machine offers 43.75 mln shares in IPO.

text.p: Singapore-based Excel Machine Tools Ltd said on Tuesday it was offering 43.75 million shares at Singapore $0.63 each in its initial public offer (IPO).
The company designs, manufactures and markets machine tools.
Excel said it would placed out 6.5 million shares and the remaining 37.25 million shares would be offered to the public, including 4.38 million shares reserved for its staff.
The offer represents 25 percent of the company's enlarged issued capital of S$175 million shares.
The shares are offered at a historical price earnings ratio based on the financial year ended September 30 1996 of 17.45 times.
Excel said in a statement it will raise about S$20.85 million from the issue. Funds will to be used to repay bank borrowings, regional expansion, general working capital and others.
For the financial year ended September 30 1996, Excel recorded a net profit of S$5.05 million on a turnover of S$53.2 million.
The public offer opens on March 19 and will close on March 31. Trading is expected to start on a when-issued basis on April 2.
